global_constraints.animations: minimal (max 150ms duration, fade only, no bouncy/springs)

formatting.numbers: en-IN locale for Indian comma grouping (e.g., 1,00,000)

spacing_and_layout.tap_targets: Minimum 44px height and width for all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, icons)

mobile.classes: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-white border-t border-gray-200 z-50 flex justify-around items-center safe-area-pb

desktop.classes: fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen bg-white border-r border-gray-200 z-40 hidden md:flex flex-col

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 h-12 px-6 rounded-md transition-opacity duration-150 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-gray-900 border border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 h-12 px-6 rounded-md transition-opacity duration-150
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 h-12 px-6 rounded-md transition-opacity duration-150

inputs.text: h-12 w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md px-4 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:border-transparent outline-none bg-white

cards.default: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-sm

tables.header: bg-gray-50 border-y border-gray-200 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider text-left py-3 px-4
tables.cell: py-4 px-4 text-sm text-gray-900 border-b border-gray-100

animations.hover: opacity change only, no translation or scaling

domain_specific_rules.permission_aware_ui: Elements that a user lacks permission to interact with MUST be completely removed from the DOM, not just disabled.

attendance_marking.viewfinder: Large aspect-ratio-square container for camera feed
attendance_marking.button: Massive tap-to-mark button (min h-16) placed centrally at the bottom

geofence_editor.controls: Floating card overlaid on map for radius slider

testing.data_test_id: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case representing their role (e.g., login-submit-button, employee-leave-request-tab).

login_background.description: Minimal abstract light background for the login screen.
